title: Weighted full-B2 lower bound 15683754216081791/3093756829900000 for a fixed norm-one language

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. experiments.purpose: The declared terminal request checks the packed layer-23 prefix shape and digest, recomputes layers 24 through 50 and the root result, and checks all 72 exact entropy inequalities. Request one follow-up on this experiment with {"phase":"energy"} to regenerate and compare every layer-23 state pair from the maximal boundary and to independently compute the split energy and initial majority. Both reports name the same exact prefix digest.
